findings.title: Changed-padding actor fanout shifts by the padding value
findings.detail: The Padding 11 Verdana fanout is a direct counterexample to the claimed actor composition. Rust moves the actor and downstream graph right by about 11px and paints the actor label at x=17 where Java paints x=6. That is not a harmless font metric residue; it indicates the padded actor text block and painted-envelope normalization are not Java-compatible.

findings.detail: The Padding 5 actor font override and Padding 0 Arial stereotype controls both fail structurally. Some differences may involve font metrics, but the actor mechanism account explicitly included font, stereotype, padding-zero, and topology axes as validation requirements.
